messages:
Maria S: Heads-up — Scanline (large media customer) wants a BYO-KMS POC. Requirements: HSM-backed keys, key ops latency target <15ms for sign/decrypt, 99.95% availability during business hours, and a pen-test scheduled 2024-11-15. They also want a hard rotation window with zero-app-change swap if possible. Can we scope?
Alex W: Thanks. Couple quick clarifying q's: do they want Redwood Private (VPC) or Dedicated with HSM proxy?
Maria S: Prefer Private (VPC) but open to Dedicated if latency/throughput better. They emphasized cross-region failover for DR.
Jamal K: For <15ms KMS ops we can't route to a remote HSM every call. Recommend: local Dedicated GPU pool + local HSM proxy in same AZ, or use customer CloudHSM colocated in region and run Redwood Private in that VPC.
Olivia (Solutions): Agree with Jamal. Also need to confirm TPS: what's expected qps for key operations?
Maria S: They said ~400 signing ops/s peak, 100 sustained. Bursty media transcoding.
Jamal K: 400 TPS signing is nontrivial. We should plan for batching and ephemeral wrapping keys to reduce HSM ops. Suggest architecture: Redwood runtime issues ephemeral CEKs, wrapped by HSM only on rotation or first use per chunk. Cuts HSM QPS by ~10x.
Alex W: Can you sketch the handshake/network reqs we need to give customer? They'll want firewall and egress constraints for their security team.
Olivia (Solutions): I'll draft. Quick snippet to give them now:
```
- Source IPs: 34.128.12.9/32 (redwood-proxy-1), 34.128.12.10/32 (redwood-proxy-2)
- TLS: mutual TLS required, port 8443
- Allowed outbound to HSM: 10.10.0.0/24 (cust-cloudhsm in VPC)
- Keepalive: 30s, idle timeout: 300s
```
Alex W: Perfect. Also: they asked for attestation docs (FIPS/HSM vendor cert) + our KMS key lifecycle runbook.
DeployBot: Preflight checklist created: POC-Scanline-BYO-2024-10. Items: network test, perf baseline, sec questionnaire complete, legal SOW.
Maria S: Pricing question from customer: what delta between Dedicated + HSM proxy vs Private with pass-through? Need a ballpark for procurement today.
Olivia (Solutions): Ballpark: Dedicated w/ reserved capacity + managed HSM proxy ~ $18k/mo incl. GPU reservation; Private with pass-through HSM (customer-managed HSM) has platform fee + setup ~ $25k/mo first-year (higher setup), but gives them complete key custody. Exact depends on reserved GPU tier and egress.
Maria S: Noted. Add note: they may ask for monthly commit discount and split billing for HSM vendor egress.
Jamal K: Technical blocker: our automatic rotation currently causes a short rollover gap (~10-30s) when rewrapping keys. They asked for "zero-app-change" rotation. We can support zero-switch if they accept ephemeral CEKs and minor SDK change (auto-fetch unwrap). Otherwise need a coordinated dual-key swap in their app.
Alex W: Can we offer a flow for zero-switch?
Olivia (Solutions): Yes — flow: 1) duplicate key handle in HSM as "next" with same policy, 2) Redwood serve both keys concurrently for a 2hr overlap, 3) gradually prefer new key. Need SOW item and an ops runbook.
LegalBot: Please have customer complete Sec Questionnaire (link: https://redwood.internal/sec-qa) and provide vendor attestation for HSM (FIPS cert + vendor POA). Also flag: export controls if keys used for certain crypto algos.
Maria S: Pen-test window: they booked external vendor for 2024-11-15. Ops needs final config by 2024-10-30. Can we hit that?
Jamal K: Tight but doable if network + perf baseline done by 10/20. Need 2 weeks to provision Dedicated pool and HSM proxy, 1 week for perf tuning.
Olivia (Solutions): I'll propose this timeline in SOW draft: Kickoff 10/07, network tests 10/11, provision 10/14-10/21, perf baseline 10/22-10/25, freeze/hand-off 10/30.
Alex W: Action items: @Jamal K to confirm HSM proxy capacity and ops runbook by EOW. @Olivia to draft SOW + pricing line items and send to Maria. @LegalBot to send sec-qa link + required attestations to customer. Maria to respond to customer with timeline and provisional pricing.
Maria S: Sounds good. One more customer ask: can they bring their own HSM (on-prem appliance) and have Redwood talk to it over a tunnel?
Jamal K: Yes but multi-hop cross-region latency will kill <15ms SLA unless HSM in same AZ/VPC. If they insist on on-prem, recommend colocated edge or dedicated site-to-site with high-throughput link; call out unsupported sub-15ms guarantee.
Olivia (Solutions): I'll include on-prem BYO option as a risk item in SOW.
Maria S: Thanks team — I'll update Scanline. Will post back with customer security contact and the completed sec-qa. :thumbsup:
Alex W: :thumbsup:
Jamal K: :ok_hand: 
Olivia (Solutions): Will follow up with draft SOW by tomorrow.
